title: KnowledgeLifecycleRules
description: Thresholds of the Knowledge lifecycle candidate -> provisional -> supported -> confirmed -> disputed / stale (HAR-97 §11, ADR-0013). Data, not code: the Go lifecycle (core-go/internal/knowledge) loads contracts/knowledge/lifecycle.v1.json. HAR-97: 'Exact thresholds are ours to tune; do not pretend they come from competitors.' Precedence per evaluation: disputed, then stale, then the highest earned rung; the ladder never moves down except into disputed or stale, and leaves them when their condition no longer holds.

applicable_statuses.description: Statuses whose knowledge may be offered to the matcher for decision guidance (mirrors the partial index knowledge_applicable_idx, migration 0007).

rungs.description: Promotion ladder in ascending order; a rung is earned when every minimum holds and the counterexample share is at most max_counterexample_share. counterexample share = counterexamples / (decisions + counterexamples), 0 when both are 0.

dispute.description: Disputed when counterexamples >= min_counterexamples AND share >= min_counterexample_share, OR negative reactions >= min_negative_reactions AND negative reactions > positive reactions.

narrow_candidate.description: Optional (HAR-97 §11: one human correction can immediately create a narrow candidate and improve a very similar future case; HAR-129 step 32). A knowledge object that is still a candidate is nevertheless offered to the matcher when it was minted from a human's explicit correction (provenance.created_from is one of created_from), names the decision episode it was learned from, that episode supports it (counts.decisions >= min_decisions), and its scope is not too broad (knowledge.ScopeTooBroad: at least two situation fields, one reading the account's state), except that knowledge matched by similarity (knowledge_similarity.v1.json applies_to_created_from) is bounded by the similarity threshold and minimum comparable features at match time instead (ADR-0013 amendment 2). Its status stays candidate: it earns provisional only through a positive customer reaction, and a dispute or stale verdict removes it. Absent: only applicable_statuses are offered (ADR-0013 before its amendment).

stale.description: Stale when no supporting evidence validated it for after_days (from last_validated_at, else created_at). New supporting evidence re-validates it.
